title: infer step config
description: Streams a generation from a text-generation model, writes the text to the context and records tool-call and reasoning diagnostics.

model_id.description: Logical id of a published text-generation model.

output_field.description: Context key receiving the full generated text (reasoning included unless strip_thinking is true).

tags.description: Reasoning and tool-call markers, inline or a bare string naming a workspace tags entry by id.

oneOf.description: Id of a workspace tags entry; an unknown id fails the load.

context.description: Typed Jinja variables (for example enable_thinking: false or reasoning_effort: medium) merged into the rendering context and forwarded as template_context when the engine renders the messages itself.

system.description: Jinja template prepended as a system turn, merged into the caller's system message when there is one.

inject_tools.description: When false, the caller's tools are hidden from the prompt.

server_tools.description: When false, the server-owned todo tools (set_todos, complete_todo, ask_user) are hidden from this step.

strip_thinking.description: When true, the span between the reasoning tags is removed from the stream, the step output and the conversation.

stream_thinking.description: For role internal steps only: forward reasoning deltas to the client while content and tool deltas stay suppressed.

trim_history.description: Drop older turns so the prompt plus max_tokens fits the engine's context window.

tool_extraction_template.description: A built-in dialect name (chatml-json, xml-function, gemma-call, glm-name-json, harmony) or inline Jinja rendering a JSON array of name and arguments from output and tools; unset tries chatml-json, xml-function and gemma-call in that order.

chat_template.description: A workspace templates id or inline Jinja replacing the model's own chat template for this step.

prompt.description: Prompt source: structured messages replacing the conversation, or one raw template (inline, file or workspace id) bypassing the chat template; a template takes precedence over messages and at most one template key may be set.

messages.description: Templated messages replacing the conversation; the result still goes through the chat template.

template.description: Inline raw Jinja template sent as a bare prompt, bypassing the chat template.

template_file.description: Path to a raw template file, resolved under the templates base directory unless absolute.

template_id.description: Id of a workspace templates entry, resolved to its content at load time.

role.description: Role of the turn; a blank role means user and an unknown one is treated as user.

content.description: Jinja template rendered against the pipeline context.

sampling.description: Step-level sampling; values apply only when non-zero, except temperature where 0 is greedy, and a request or loop retry override wins.

max_tokens.description: Completion cap, also the reservation trim_history keeps free; 0 keeps the engine default.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature; 0 is greedy and a negative value keeps the engine default.

top_p.description: Nucleus threshold; 0 keeps the engine default.

tagMarker.description: A marker string, or a list whose first entry is the primary marker and the rest are alternatives (longest match wins).

tags.description: Inline reasoning and tool-call channel markers.

reasoning_open.description: Marker or markers opening the reasoning channel.

reasoning_close.description: Marker or markers closing the reasoning channel.

reasoning_repeatable.description: Whether the reasoning channel may reopen within one generation, as chained-channel dialects such as Harmony need; unset keeps the engine rule.

tool_open.description: Marker or markers opening the tool-call channel; a generation ending inside it finishes with tool_calls.

tool_close.description: Marker or markers closing the tool-call channel.
